text:
Anya (PM): FYI competitor announced a "native rerank" + "dedicated tier" today. Sales is getting heated. Need a quick decision on roadmap shifts.
Devin (Eng): Saw it. Their feature set looks narrow; no observability or routing. We shouldn't go full parity.
Sophia (Sales): Two pilots are explicit: they want a drop-in rerank endpoint or they'll pick the competitor. This is blocking deals.
Matt (ML): Classify: (1) API parity surface (rerank wrapper) is low effort, high unlock. (2) Pricing parity is business-level and risky.
Leo (Design): If we expose a compatibility endpoint, docs must make differences clear. Don't let customers assume identical behavior.
Anya (PM): Proposed two-lane plan: quick compatibility adapter (short-lived, for pilots) + preserve long-term differentiators (console, routing, cost controls). Can we scope the adapter?
Devin (Eng): Quick spike to estimate. Rough tasks: adapter endpoint + auth shim, request/response mapper, regression tests, perf benchmark.
Sophia (Sales): If adapter in 2 sprints we convert ~120k ARR from pilots but they'll want a canary. Need legal on pricing language.
Matt (ML): Add quality gate: top-3 accuracy delta <= 2% on pilot prompts. We'll run evals and a small CV bench.
Anya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: API accepts items[] + query; response returns rank scores; P95 latency <= 1.2x gen API; top-3 delta <= 2%; feature-flagged rollout with canary + auto-fallback.
Devin (Eng): Spike owners: @Devin + @Matt. ETA 5 working days. We'll post perf gist in thread.
Leo (Design): I'll prepare a compatibility page + FAQ to avoid "full parity" messaging.
Sophia (Sales): I'll line up legal/comms. We must not promise exact pricing parity; emphasize observability + TCO.
Anya (PM): Risks: reassign 1 FE + 1 BE for 2 sprints; maybe delay small infra polish. Are we okay deprioritizing autoscale polish?
Devin (Eng): We can reassign if autoscale polish is delayed 2 weeks. Not ideal but doable.
Matt (ML): Add an Optimize regression alert to catch quality drift post-launch.
Anya (PM): Next steps: spike kickoff today (1729999999); delivery plan by Thu EOD (1730001234); Sophia to confirm pilot commitment; Leo to push docs draft to /docs/compatibility by Fri. Reconvene Thu 11am to review spike and decide final scope.
ops-bot: deploybot pushed branch `compat-adapter/spike` to staging — build 482 passed :party:
Anya (PM): Thanks all. If objections, speak now.
